card.name: Partway through repeated words and names
card.fires_on: Fires on the next piece of a word or number that has just appeared earlier in the text, such as the middle of a drug name, the end of overdosage, or the number after ASSIGNMENT.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Fires partway through a drug name that is being repeated from earlier text.

modes.label: Table and list items
modes.description: Fires on the space or digit in a repeated table label such as ASSIGNMENT 3 or a date.

modes.label: Ends of medical words
modes.description: Fires on the ending of words like overdosage or discontinue.
